description.narrative: The Global Network Against Food Crises scope is to prevent, prepare and respond to food crisis and support the collective outcomes related to Ending Hunger (SDG 2); It operates at a) national, b) regional and c) global level on three dimensions: 1) Data & Analitics - Understanding food crises 2) Strategic Investment in food and nutrition security to prepare, prevent and respond to food crises; 3) beyond food functional coordination with other dimensions of food crisis scenarios
